newsitem.title: INDIA: India's CARE assigns A plus to Garware Polyester.
newsitem.headline: India's CARE assigns A plus to Garware Polyester.

text.p: CARE has assigned a 'CARE A+' Single A plus rating to the debenture issue of 500 million rupees of Garware Polyester Ltd. Instruments with this rating are considered upper medium grade instruments and have many favourable investment attributes.

Safety for principal and interest are considered adequate. Assumptions that do not materialise may have a greater impact as compared to the instruments rated higher. The NCDs are being issued to augment the long term working capital resources.
Garware Polyester Ltd. (GPL) is managed by Shri Shashikant B. Garware (CMD) who has over four decades of wide ranging experience in business and industry.

It is the largest integrated domestic manufacturer of polyester film in the country, in the thickness range from 10 microns to 350 microns. Polyester film finds extensive applications. GPL is the sole manufacturer in India, of films for audio tapes and electrical insulations and reprographic-grade films. Besides, it is one of the only two manufacturers of UV-stabilished sun control polyester film in the world.
